text:
Maria_CS: draft playbook to reduce renewal risk by aligning caching/batching/streaming guidance with customer comms. want quick review before i send to AMs. TL;DR — 3 risk tiers, suggested outreach scripts, and tech checklist for us + customers.
Sam_Eng: love that. can you paste the tech checklist here?
Maria_CS: yep — main items: 1) confirm prefix cache warmup window (48h default), 2) recommended batch_size per route (3–8 for short requests, 12–20 for long-block jobs), 3) streaming fallback enabled for interactive flows, 4) telemetry flags to watch: avg token latency, cache hit %, burst dropped requests.
Jules_Support: for customer-facing wording we should avoid deep numbers. maybe give ranges and a one-line explanation of why it matters (cost vs latency).
Olivia_CE: suggested customer script for a Tier 2 renewal risk: "We noticed bursts causing token-cost spikes. Quick win: enable prefix caching and reduce per-request prompts by ~10% — our team can send a config snippet and help schedule a warmup window." thoughts?
Sam_Eng: snippet looks good. Add the exact API param names: `cache_policy: "prefix"`, `batch_hint: <int>`, `streaming: true/false` and an example curl.
Maria_CS: noted. curl example: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/configs \n-H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \n-d '{"route":"customer-route","cache_policy":"prefix","batch_hint":8,"streaming":true}'```
Ben_SRE: add a note for Dedicated customers: set `burst_capacity: enabled` and coordinate a scale-up 24h before big launches. also record expected RPS in the ticket.
Jules_Support: i added a short troubleshooting section: common cause = stale cache keys after model rollouts; fix = invalidate prefix cache + run a short warmup with representative prompts. also include exact invalidation command.
Maria_CS: good call. invalidation snippet: ```POST /admin/cache/invalidate \n{ "route":"customer-route","prefix":"v1:conversation:" }```
Olivia_CE: can we include a simple playbook timeline for AMs? like Day 0 (config sent), Day 1 (apply, run warmup 1k requests), Day 3 (check telemetry), Day 7 (follow-up renewal health).
Sam_Eng: add acceptance criteria: cache hit% > 40% for interactive flows or cost reductions >= 10% for batch jobs. otherwise escalate to SRE.
Maria_CS: final ask — approve this phrasing for customer email and the tech checklist. if no major edits i'll ship to AMs EOD.
oncall-bot: Reminder: create an ops ticket for any Dedicated scale changes — link to runbook required.
Jules_Support: approved from support side.
Ben_SRE: approved but add a line about rolling back batch_hint to 1 if latency regressions observed.
Olivia_CE: approved — can we add a short survey question so AMs capture whether customers accepted config changes? one-liner: "Did you accept the recommended caching/batching changes? (yes/no)"
Maria_CS: done. thanks all — i'll send the playbook and paste the final customer-safe docs into the AM template. will link the ops ticket here when created.
Sam_Eng: thanks, Maria. quick nit: add example metrics dashboard pointer (Console -> Routes -> latency / token-cost).
Maria_CS: added. sending now. :rocket:
